reaudit.method: Re-read all 50 seed-11 rows against the five-point rubric after the fixes, then re-rendered the same sheet with --from and re-ran the deck, romanization and content guard tests.
reaudit.result: All 7 fixed cards read clean and no new defect was found; the sheet now shows the corrected rows.

systemicIssues.detail: The transliterator left ㄹ as l after ㄴ/ㅁ/ㅇ, so 대통령 and 음료수 were romanized daetonglyeong and eumlyosu instead of daetongnyeong and eumnyosu. The same rule also corrected 정력 (essential_142), which this sheet did not sample.

systemicIssues.issue: Examples that do not say what they mean
systemicIssues.detail: One used the wrong particle for the car's tire pressure, one used 묻었는지 so the sentence never said what was wiped, and one used the year counter 년 for age, which takes 살.

systemicIssues.issue: Usage notes with inaccurate sense claims
systemicIssues.detail: The 물고기 note limited 생선 to cooked fish, and the 피 note called 혈액 a compound of 피; both claims misdescribe the words.

notes: Each of the 50 seed-11 rows was read against the five-point rubric (translation, naturalness, politeness, part of speech, romanization/batchim), with usage-note claims checked separately; no deck data was edited during the audit.
This is a model screen, not the pending Korean-speaker spot check.
The sheet was sampled with --unaudited, so none of the 235 cards audited in samples 1-5 was re-read and every row is new evidence.
Seven of 50 fail (14%), inside the 5-15% band; the sweep continues in 50-card batches, with 219 imported cards left.
The romanization fix also corrects essential_142 (정력), which was not in this sheet, because data.test.ts keeps every stored romanization equal to the transliterator.
Three rewritten examples (essential_018, essential_257, essential_395) already had male sentence clips, so those three clips were regenerated and the index updated; no other audio changed.

issues.detail: The note said 생선 is for cooked fish; 생선 is the word for fish as food, raw or cooked, while 물고기 names the animal.

verdicts.resolution: Rewrote the note to contrast the animal word 물고기 with the food word 생선.

issues.detail: 차에 타이어 공기압을 확인했어요 uses the location particle 에 where the car owns the tire pressure; the sentence needs 차의 (or no 차).

verdicts.resolution: Changed the example to 차의 타이어 공기압을 확인했어요 and the translation to 'I checked the car's tire pressure.'

issues.detail: daetonglyeong leaves ㄹ as l; after ㅇ the ㄹ assimilates to n, so the Revised Romanization is daetongnyeong.

verdicts.resolution: Taught the transliterator the ㄴ/ㅁ/ㅇ + ㄹ → n rule and set the stored romanization to daetongnyeong.

issues.detail: eumlyosu leaves ㄹ as l; after ㅁ it assimilates to n, so the Revised Romanization is eumnyosu.

verdicts.resolution: The same transliterator fix sets the stored romanization to eumnyosu.

issues.detail: 그는 초콜릿을 먹다가 입술에 묻었는지 닦았어요 links 묻었는지 ('whether it got on') to 닦다, so the sentence never says what he wiped and the English guessed 'maybe because'.

verdicts.resolution: Replaced it with 입술에 묻은 것을 닦았어요 and updated the English to 'He wiped off the chocolate that got on his lips while eating.'

issues.detail: The note called 혈액 a compound of 피; 혈액 is a separate Sino-Korean word, not a compound containing 피.

verdicts.resolution: Rewrote the note to contrast everyday 피 with medical 혈액 and to keep the idiom mention.

issues.detail: 스물다섯 년이 되었어요 uses the year counter 년 for age, which takes 살; the example does not show how 년 is actually used.

verdicts.resolution: Replaced it with 한국에 온 지 삼 년이 되었어요 ('It has been three years since I came to Korea') and updated the English.
